item.title: Students report mood shifts, productivity rise with warmer weather
item.description: Snow flurries fell across campus as temperatures dropped back below freezing on Friday, Feb. 20, a sharp reminder that winter isn’t finished with Chicago just yet. item.title: Faculty, staff spotlight their work in Glass Curtain Gallery showcase
item.description: More than 40 faculty and staff members are exhibiting their own creative work in the Glass Curtain Gallery, turning the space into a cross-section of the School of Visual Arts’ artistic practice. item.title: Hokin Gallery previews MoCP’s Darkroom Auction ahead of 50th anniversary fundraiser
item.description: The Hokin Gallery is exhibiting photographs and artwork that will be auctioned as part of the annual Darkroom Auction, a fundraiser for the Museum of Contemporary Photography. item.title: Chronicle wins 34 ICPA awards, named best student newspaper for mid-sized schools
item.description: The Columbia Chronicle earned the top newspaper honor in the mid-sized schools division at the annual Illinois College Press Association contest, collecting 34 awards across reporting, photography, video and design.
